This is the limitation statement of the Glidrose limited edition, bound in plain dark brown cloth with white wavy line design and O.H.M.S. on spine, which matches the known limited issue binding. condition: OHMSS: spine and cloth wear, rubbing at edges, no dust jacket; text block looks sound. Medical book worn.
reason: Possible Fleming OHMSS limited edition (250 numbered, signed); if genuine worth thousands, check the limitation leaf and signature.
